retraction.reason: A15(5): the sentence this edge quotes states a cause, and the cause it states is the dissolution of the Soviet Union — "all support to the Democratic Republic was stopped, leading to the toppling of the government" — not the Soviet–Afghan War, which had ended three years earlier. An edge drawn from the article’s own subject has the direction right and the cause wrong. The link is written from dissolution-of-the-soviet-union instead.

explanation: The Soviet war’s lead runs straight into the civil war of 1992: the support that stopped in 1991 is what the government fell without. The article reads: "Following the dissolution of the Soviet Union in December 1991, all support to the Democratic Republic was stopped, leading to the toppling of the government by the mujahideen in 1992 and the start of a second Afghan Civil War (1992–1996)."
